project_overview.name: Wedding Planner SaaS
project_overview.description: Platform SaaS multi-tenant kolaborasi real-time pasangan. Freemium 50k/6 bulan, renewable. 6 modul inti hasil konsolidasi 9 fitur (Timeline+Checklist gabung, Mahar+Seserahan gabung, Target+Cashflow gabung). Bridesmaid masuk Tamu kategori bridesmaid + Budget Busana.
project_overview.business_model: Freemium 50k/6 bulan. Gratis selesaikan nikahan intim 50 tamu. Premium unlimited + upload + export. Jika expired bisa perpanjang (renew). Lifetime tidak, periodik 6 bulan.

decisions_2026_08_25.bridesmaid: hapus modul terpisah → Tamu kategori=bridesmaid + Budget kategori Busana
decisions_2026_08_25.berkas_kua: gratis dasar (10 checklist tanpa upload), premium upload/scan/expiry/CPP-CPW terpisah
decisions_2026_08_25.subscription: 50k/6 bulan renewable, bukan lifetime. Tambah plan.duration_months=6, wedding.plan_expires_at
decisions_2026_08_25.priority: Mahar & Seserahan dulu (sprint 1), Keuangan Cashflow setelahnya (sprint 2)

database.multi_tenant_strategy: Single DB, kolom wedding_id ROW-LEVEL, FK CASCADE/SET NULL

features: Template 12 bulan default auto-generate 30 task dari wedding_date (due_date = wedding_date - X hari)
Status todo/in_progress/done, kategori seserahan/kua/vendor/dekorasi/undangan/catering/busana/dokumentasi/hiburan/lainnya, assignee pria/wanita/both, order drag
View Timeline (Gantt) + Daftar, warna kategori, filter status/kategori
CRUD tamu: name, email, phone, category(family/friend/vip/general/bridesmaid), side(bride/groom/both), rsvp(pending/attending/declined), pax, notes, angpao_tracker
Limit 50 gratis, unlimited premium, import Excel, group VIP/Keluarga, Tamu kategori bridesmaid masuk sini
Bridesmaid budget seragam masuk modul Budget kategori Busana (bukan modul terpisah)
Checklist 10 berkas wajib (KTP, KK, Akta, N1-N4, Sehat, pas foto) tanpa upload — gratis
Premium: upload scan, file_url, expiry_date alert, progres CPP vs CPW terpisah (Numpang Nikah trigger), panduan Bimwin/Simkah, verifikasi KUA
CRUD vendor: vendor_name, category, kontak WA, total_amount, dp_amount, paid_amount, status(belum_bayar/dp/lunas), due_date, invoice_url, notes
Gratis: locked/preview, Premium unlimited + reminder pelunasan H-7 + chart vs alokasi
Type mahar/seserahan_cpp/seserahan_cpw/hantaran, title, qty, estimated_cost, actual_cost, status(rencana/dibeli/dicicil/selesai), tenor_total/terbayar, linkage budget
Gratis preview 5 item, Premium unlimited + cicilan tracker + budget linkage Busana/Adat

Progress %, grafik cashflow, Kantong Bersama invite pasangan, linkage ke Vendor/Mahar

premium_gating.premium_50k_6bulan: Unlimited tamu/vendor/mahar, upload KUA, progress CPP/CPW, cicilan, full cashflow + grafik, export Excel/PDF, reminder WA, keluarga/WO read-only 2-3, renewable per 6 bulan

database_schema_summary.existing: users, weddings (plan_id, total_budget, wedding_date, pair_code), wedding_users, guests(category inc bridesmaid, side, rsvp), checklists(category, status, order, assignee), plans(price, max_guests), orders(status, amount, proof_url)
